internal/server/repos.go:369 `data.ScannedAt = entry.ScannedAt` runs unconditionally after the cache/fresh-scan branch. When a fresh scan is taken (data.Cached=false) and repos.Status errors, `entry` is never reassigned by statusCache.Store (guarded by `if err == nil`), so it still holds whatever statusCache.Get returned earlier -- the prior stale entry when the repo was scanned before. The rendered fragment then shows the error banner alongside a stale ScannedAt timestamp from a scan that never ran for this render. Genuine in-range defect (handleRepoWorktreeStatus is new/rewritten in this diff); no golden entry addresses ScannedAt staleness on a cache-miss scan error.

internal/acdsl/git.go's GitShowFile (called from policy.go, the file the candidate cites) distinguishes absent-path from a hard error via `errors.As(err, &exec.ExitError)` on shell.Run's return; if shell.Run ever stopped preserving the underlying *exec.ExitError through its wrapping, GitShowFile would silently misreport every absent path as a hard error instead of ok=false. Genuine, minor, in-range coupling in new code; no golden entry flags this specific contract dependency.
